authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/sonicware/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/sonicware/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter is a control change the chart marks recognized, its name the chart's remark, sent on the channel of its block. The chart prints no values: each is 0 - 127. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

The chart puts the master, master effect, delay, reverb and input controllers on the project channel and the track ones on the track's (or the AUTO channel): set projectChannel and the channel variable to the instrument's.
Left out, the wheel, the pedals and the channel mode messages: CC 120 ALL SOUND OFF.

coverage.inboundControllers: the instrument sends the controllers its chart marks transmitted
